description: Defines an abstract class 'VideoFrameBuffer' with virtual methods for accessing video frame data and properties, used in WebRTC streaming within the 'cuttlefish' project.

classes.name: VideoFrameBuffer
classes.description: An abstract base class representing a video frame buffer with methods to access frame dimensions, strides, data pointers, and data sizes.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Returns the width of the video frame.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Returns the height of the video frame.

methods.name: StrideY
methods.description: Returns the stride (bytes per row) for the Y (luminance) plane.

methods.name: StrideU
methods.description: Returns the stride for the U (chrominance) plane.

methods.name: StrideV
methods.description: Returns the stride for the V (chrominance) plane.

methods.name: DataY
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the Y plane data.

methods.name: DataU
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the U plane data.

methods.name: DataV
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the V plane data.

methods.name: DataSizeY
methods.description: Returns the size of the Y plane data in bytes.

methods.name: DataSizeU
methods.description: Returns the size of the U plane data in bytes.

methods.name: DataSizeV
methods.description: Returns the size of the V plane data in bytes.
